column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#2228's fixture-table coverage for CleanupPostgresTestData/CleanupMySQLTestData/CleanupMSSQLTestData, looped over all three dialects via testutil.TestDB. postgres RUNS in this PostgreSQL-only job; mysql and mssql skip -- two, not three. The arms have to exist even where they skip because the whole point is that the three dialects' cleanup tables were extended by hand and can drift independently -- a postgres-only run cannot observe a missing MySQL or MSSQL table.
